thread:
Emily Rivera: Quick check-in 1: finalizing the launch blog for Dedicated Runtime. Need: legal signoff on performance claims, PR quote, final hero image, and HubSpot tracking before we hit publish. Draft is in the doc: https://drive.google.com/d/1-dedicated-launch-draft

Jordan Lee: reading now. Two quick notes: (1) let's avoid absolutes like 'always' or 'never' in the performance section; (2) headline feels product-first 1 want customer benefit up top.

Priya Nair: SEO pass done. Suggested meta title and description in the doc. Also added target keywords: "inference cost", "dedicated runtime", "low latency inference". Recommend we keep headline under 70 chars for SERP.

Ben Thompson: Legal here 1 please point me to the benchmark appendix and the exact phrasing you plan to publish for throughput/cost.

Emily Rivera: benchmark appendix: https://drive.google.com/d/1-dedicated-bench-appendix. Planned callout: "Our Dedicated runtime delivers up to 2.8x throughput and reduces per-token cost by up to 45% under our default batching profile."

Carlos Mendez: PR input: we'll want a short, quote-ready sentence from an engineering lead. Rafael is OOO; can we get a quote from Serena? I can ask. Also PR wants the embargo date if we plan outreach.

Ben Thompson: I'll review the appendix tonight and flag anything risky. "Up to" language is helpful; include test setup details in the appendix (hardware, models, workloads) and we should be clear it's representative not universal.

Priya Nair: note for tracking: UTMs we recommend: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=dedicated_rt_2026-03. Add hidden field product_line=dedicated and origin=blog on the form. Which form id are we using?

Emily Rivera: using HS form 412. @Ben once legal clears, can we get a short approval comment in this thread so I can lock the post?

Jordan Lee: copy edits: replaced second para with customer problem + moved the tech appendix link to the end. Also tightened the CTA: "Register for our launch webinar" -> "Join our webinar: live demo + Q&A".

Marketing Bot: Asset checklist: hero image (1200x675): missing, social card variants: missing, alt text: draft. SEO: meta saved (status: ready). Legal review: pending. Publish window requested (Thu 10am PT).

Carlos Mendez: webinar blurb drafted: "Join our engineering lead for a walkthrough of Dedicated runtime performance patterns, deployment tips, and live Q&A." I'll add registration link once Serena confirms availability.

Ben Thompson: legal note: appendix looks good overall. Two tweaks requested: (1) add a sentence clarifying the benchmark "baseline" configuration; (2) replace "reduces per-token cost" -> "reduces per-token cost in our tests". Approving copy pending those edits.

Emily Rivera: good catches. I'll update the bench callout to: "Our tests show Dedicated runtime can deliver up to 2.8x throughput and reduce per-token cost by up to 45% under our default batching profile." Posting an updated snippet in the doc now.

Priya Nair: UTMs and hidden fields confirmed. I'll also add canonical tags and schema for the blog post.

Jordan Lee: design ping: can you drop hero and 2 social variants into s3://redwood-marketing/dedicated-launch/assets by EOD? We need them for social scheduling.

Carlos Mendez: Serena can provide the quote. ETA 24 hours. I set PR embargo to Thu 10am PT, matching publish window.

Marketing Bot: Update: legal review (status: minor edits), assets (status: pending upload), publish window (requested Thu 10am PT). Add label #ready-for-publish once assets and legal are done.

Emily Rivera: action list: 1) finish minor legal wording (Ben) 2) design uploads to S3 (Design) 3) final hero alt text + meta (Priya) 4) Serena quote + webinar link (Carlos) 5) schedule publish once all green. Sync in 30 min to confirm. Thanks! :rocket:
